Restart first. It really does fix a lot of problems.
Use a password manager and a different password everywhere.
Turn on two-factor authentication wherever you can.
Back up 3-2-1: 3 copies, 2 kinds of storage, 1 offsite.
Test your backups. One you can't restore isn't a backup.
Win + Shift + S takes a screenshot of part of the screen.
Ctrl + Shift + Esc opens Task Manager straight away.
Win + V opens clipboard history on Windows.
Win + L locks your PC. Do it when you walk away.
Slow PC at boot? Check Startup apps in Task Manager.
Keep your system and apps updated. Updates patch holes.
Hover over a link before clicking to see where it goes.
Ctrl + Shift + T reopens the browser tab you just closed.
Ctrl + L jumps to the browser address bar.
F12 opens browser dev tools. Great for learning HTML.
Wi-Fi acting up? Unplug the router for 30 seconds.
Ping 1.1.1.1 to check if your internet works at all.
Websites not loading right? Try ipconfig /flushdns.
Never share a 2FA code. Real support will never ask.
Phishing emails try to rush you. Slow down and check.
Public Wi-Fi? Stick to HTTPS sites or use a trusted VPN.
Encrypt your laptop: BitLocker on Windows, FileVault on Mac.
On Linux, df -h shows how much disk space is left.
On Linux, htop shows what is eating your CPU and RAM.
On Ubuntu: sudo apt update, then sudo apt upgrade.
On a Mac, Cmd + Space opens Spotlight search.
Search the exact error message. Someone had it before.
Check the cable before reinstalling anything.
Dust kills PCs. Clean fans with short bursts of air.
Label your cables. Future you will say thanks.
Uninstall apps you don't use. Less stuff, fewer problems.
Empty your Downloads folder now and then.
Write down what you changed so you can undo it later.
Run git status often. It tells you what is going on.
Good commit messages say why, not just what.
Ctrl + Z undo, Ctrl + Y redo, Ctrl + S save. Save often.
Use a surge protector for your PC and router.
Before helping, ask: what changed right before it broke?
Be patient with people asking for help. Be nice :3
